description:
THE BEING HARD ON YOURSELF IS A HUGE PART OF THE PROBLEM.

Now that’s not to say it’s easy to stop! Or that others, or society and culture, don’t criticise you too.

But at the very least would you look to lighten the load? 

See if you can find ways to give yourself love and space, rather than indictment.

You’re not broken. You’re not useless. You’re human. And you have big things ahead.

But if you need an extra hand, throw a ‘HELP’ in the comments and I’ll message you for a chat 🔥

.
.
.
.
.
.
#growth #procrastination #perfectionism #lifecoach #selflove #gentle
transcript: Not for your bullshit! You're incredible! The reason you feel useless is you've been criticizing yourself so constantly that every time you want to do something you avoid it in order to protect yourself from failing which makes you feel useless! You're capable of extraordinary things, but gentleness and meeting yourself where you are has to come first! And if now you've just started criticizing yourself for criticizing yourself, STOP! We love you, we think you're great, please be kind to yourself so we can stop worrying about you! I'm going this way if you want to come.
spoken_hook_0_3s: Not for your bullshit! You're incredible! The reason you feel useless
